title: Rollback suggestion heuristics for structured output degradation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Implement a heuristic-based rollback suggestion system that automatically correlates structured-output quality regressions (JSON/schema failures, field-level distribution shifts, and per-field quality drops) to recent model/config deltas and surfaces a confidence-ranked rollback recommendation to on-call and the Console rollout UI.

Why: We have frequent small regressions after model variant and config changes (temperature, sampling, quantization profiles, kernel selection). Current alerting surfaces failures but does not provide actionability — engineers must manually attribute the cause. Proposing a lightweight, deterministic scorer that uses signal correlation, causal hints from rollout metadata, and a conservative rollback threshold to speed mitigation while minimizing false rollbacks.

Scope: Detection + attribution pipeline, a scoring function that produces a rollback confidence score, a minimal Console UI card for suggestions with one-click record of suggested rollback, integration with canary and automatic annotation in the rollout timeline, and an ops playbook linking suggested rollback to required approvals. This ticket covers the scoring heuristics, telemetry instrumentation, and backend endpoints; UI card (frontend) work will be a follow-up (see implementation notes).
acceptance_criteria: Score generator runs when structured-output eval detects degradation above configured baseline
Rollback confidence score computed and stored alongside eval event in telemetry index
System surfaces top 3 candidate rollbacks (model version or config delta) with rationale fields
False rollback rate in internal simulation <= 5% on historical testbed
Suggested rollback can be accepted/ignored in the rollout timeline API (backend endpoint validated)
Docs and runbook updated with clear manual override steps
implementation_notes: Run heuristic scoring as part of the eval postprocessor: lightweight (under 200ms per eval event) to avoid pipeline backlog
Inputs: per-field metric deltas (precision/recall/valid JSON rate), recent config/model deltas from deployment metadata, canary population, and sample attribution traces

Scoring components: signal concordance (do multiple fields degrade together?), delta recency weighting (recent changes are more suspect), config sensitivity heatmap lookup (precomputed), and model-variant risk prior
Persist score to telemetry index: index name output_quality_rollbacks, fields: event_id, score, top_candidates, timestamp
Expose a backend endpoint POST /rollbacks/suggest to return recommendation and rationale (auth via service token)
Simulate suggestions on last 6 months of rollout events to measure false positives and recall before enabling auto-surfacing
rollback_algorithm_spec: Heuristic formula: base_score = weighted_sum(field_drop_scores) * recency_boost * config_suspicion_factor. field_drop_score = normalized(metric_drop / baseline_std). recency_boost = 1 + exp(-age_in_hours / tau) capped at 3. config_suspicion_factor derived from precomputed sensitivity table (0.5-2.0). Final rollback_confidence = sigmoid(base_score - threshold_offset). Candidates ranked by weighted attribution score where attribution = base_score * candidate_overlap_fraction. Conservative default threshold maps to ~0.9 precision on historical dataset.
ui_changes: Backend: add suggestion flag to rollout timeline API. Frontend card (follow-up ticket) will show suggestion, confidence, top candidate, and 'Propose rollback' button. Card includes links to failing samples and suggested PRs. We will wire a webhook so the suggestions appear in incident Slack channel #reliability-suggestions.
decisions: Use heuristic scorer rather than full causal inference at launch to keep latency and implementation complexity low
Persist scores to telemetry index to allow offline analysis and A/B of thresholds
Expose suggestions through backend API only; frontend opt-in gate to avoid noisy UX until thresholds calibrated
Default do-not-auto-rollback: this ticket will NOT enable automatic rollbacks; we will only surface suggestions
